scenario: [LNUL.4.9] the String tag over a String slot, un-negated — the subject whose totality has a second obligation behind it. `is String` must answer off the value's tag BEFORE any conversion, which is what lets it answer for a Json string leaf without interning anything; this fixture pins the ordinary String case that the leaf case degenerates to. Drives the eval arm with IS_SUBJECT_STRING; the rule FIRES. Paired with LNUL.4.9d's wrong-tag negative so the tag comparison is pinned in both directions on a non-numeric type as well as a numeric one. fact_count 2.
rules_ds:
schema Label scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String? mutable

schema Marker scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule r:
    Label l where l.text is String
->
    emit Marker logical entity_id: l.entity_id
